question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A place where government records are kept
solution:
The correct answer is '**Archive**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Archive**'.
 
• It means 'a collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people.' (किसी स्थान, संस्था या लोगों के समूह के बारे में जानकारी प्रदान करने वाले ऐतिहासिक दस्तावेजों या अभिलेखों का संग्रह)
 
 
• *Example: source materials in local **archives**...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Archive.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Cloakroom**: a room near the entrance to a building where you can leave your coat, bags, etc. (किसी इमारत के प्रवेश द्वार पर स्थित एक कमरा जहाँ कोट, थैले आदि समान रखे जाते हैं; अमानती सामानघर)
 
• **Cache**: an amount of something, especially drugs or weapons, that has been hidden. (गुप्‍त भंडार विशेषतः नशीले पदार्थों या हथियारों का)
 
• **Hangar**: a big building where planes are kept. (विमान को रखने की इमारत; हैंगर)
